title: neonauclea papuana
intro: Neonauclea papuana, commonly known as the Papua nauclea, is a plant species native to Papua New Guinea. It is a member of the Rubiaceae family and is valued for its medicinal properties. Neonauclea papuana has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions, and it is believed to have several health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The plant's bioactive constituents include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antiproliferative effects.
